# Kotlin Android Design Patterns - Skills Collection

This folder contains 5 expert knowledge files on design patterns for Kotlin and Android.

Each category includes practical Android examples based on ViewModel, StateFlow, Repository, UseCase, and Compose integration.

## Skills index

### Behavioral patterns
File: `behavioral-patterns.md`
- Observer/Listener, Strategy, State, Command, Chain of Responsibility, Mediator, Memento, Visitor
- Android-oriented communication and UI state cases

### Creational patterns
File: `creational-patterns.md`
- Singleton, Factory Method, Abstract Factory, Builder/DSL, Prototype, Dependency Injection
- Focus on object wiring, DI boundaries, and testability

### Structural patterns
File: `structural-patterns.md`
- Adapter, Decorator, Facade, Proxy, Composite, Bridge
- Integration and decoupling patterns for Android modules and SDKs

### Concurrency patterns
File: `concurrency-patterns.md`
- Structured concurrency, producer-consumer, actor-style isolation, flow pipelines, retry/circuit boundaries
- Focus on cancellation safety and lifecycle-aware execution

### Kotlin/Android-specific patterns
File: `kotlin-android-patterns.md`
- Sealed state reducers, repository + use case, delegation, DSL builders, Compose state patterns
- Idiomatic Kotlin patterns that reduce accidental complexity

- https://github.com/PacktPublishing/Kotlin-Design-Patterns-and-Best-Practices

## How to use
- Via agent: `android-expert-pattern`
- Via prompt: `/android-expert-patterns`
- Via direct reading: open any category file and use its selection matrix

## What this v2 adds
- End-to-end snippets with realistic Android architecture boundaries.
- Pattern explanations tied to practical app concerns (lifecycle, cancellation, testability).
- Copy-paste starter templates for refactor and interview guidance.
